propositions: Baseline fields description, status, and priority must be stored in normalized scalar form (rich text to string via normalize_rich_text, Jira name strings like 'High' and 'In Progress') to reduce serialized size by approximately 66% while maintaining exact equivalence in live comparison
Assignee field must remain unchanged as complete vendor dict to preserve all identity forms and prevent local-wins from overwriting concurrent remote assignee edits
The pre-A3 reader must accept both scalar and vendor dict shapes for backward compatibility, enabling safe rollback without lossy denormalization
Exact live compute_update_fields verdicts must be identical whether baseline stores vendor dicts or scalar equivalents, validated through held-out oracle with real Jira mappers

Pinned corpus oracle must report zero forward mutation deltas, zero rollback mutation deltas under pre-A3 code, zero assignee shape/value deltas, and at least 50% serialized size reduction across all 1,774 baselines

Production rollback is triggered by unexpected mutation verdict or reconcile error and requires Gerrit revert, validation of mixed-state store under pre-A3 code, and one successful reconcile run before re-enabling
